The answer I recall for this problem (AIME 2007 II) is 60, with the minimum equal to 38 + 19√3. I did not re-derive it here, so this rests on memory.

That value is about 70.909. Solutions 1 and 3 give numerical values near it (70.915 and 70.9377), but both are only numerical guesses at a closed form and give the wrong exact forms (18 + 20√7 and 63 + 3√7). Solution 2's 6 + 33√3 is about 63.2, which is clearly off.

The final answers are 45, 42 and 73. None of them equals 60.

CHOICE: NONE
